incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Spanish Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010, of 2 July, approving the consolidated text of the Capital Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), primary incorporation rules in Articles 1-31 and 57-62; Commercial Registry Regulations approved by Royal Decree 1784/1996; Notarial Law rules applicable to company deeds
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central and the Provincial Mercantile Registry (Commercial Register) for the province where the registered office is located
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (escritura pública constitutiva) and subsequent filing with the Mercantile Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The SL must maintain a minimum share capital of EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and fully paid-up at incorporation. Cash contributions must be deposited in a Spanish credit institution in a blocked incorporation account opened in the company's name before the deed is granted; the deposit is released only after commercial registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At a formal meeting of the founding members of the Spanish limited company, it is unanimously resolved: (1) to approve the incorporation in the form of Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada under the name and bylaws annexed; each founder subscribes and fully pays the quotas allocated to them, evidenced by the bank deposit certificate presented to the meeting; (2) to adopt as the registered and tax office the premises located at [full address], province of [Province], Spain; (3) to appoint [Name] as sole administrator, [Name] as alternate administrator, and [Name] as secretary, conferring the necessary corporate and registry powers; and (4) to execute the public deed before the appointed notary, request provisional tax identification, and complete registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the negative name certificate from the Central Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an electronic request for a certificate of absence of identical or confusingly similar company names for the proposed SL name, stating the intended trading-cards publishing and manufacturing activity. The Central Registry verifies at national level and issues the denomination certificate; the certificate validates the proposed name for incorporation.
required_dossiers: Completed name certificate application
Proposed company names in order of preference
Identity details and tax identification number/NIE of each promoter
Description of the corporate purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is suspended or rejected, resubmit within the same procedural file with alternative names or provide additional documentation proving the existing name is not confusingly similar; the certificate can be reissued with a corrected denomination.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open a blocked capital contribution account and obtain the bank deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution supervised by the Bank of Spain
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open an incorporation capital account in the future company's name, deposit at least EUR 3,000 in cash, and obtain a certificate stating the depositor, amount, account number, and the unavailable or blocked nature of the funds. The certificate is delivered to the notary for recital in the public deed; the account remains blocked until the Mercantile Registry records the deed.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate from the Central Registry
Passport or NIE of each founding shareholder
Bank anti-money-laundering identification and declaration forms
Statement of the corporate purpose and registered-office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises queries due to incomplete beneficial-owner information, complete the AML questionnaire and resubmit; if the chosen bank cannot open an account in the future company's name, open the account in the name of a founding member as depositor and, with the bank's consent, transfer the position to the company after registry inscription.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Grant the public incorporation deed before a notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary of the province of the registered office, within the Colegio Notarial
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founders attend before the chosen notary with the final bylaws, denomination certificate, bank deposit certificate, and identification documents. The notary verifies legal capacity, corporate purpose, capital subscription, quota allocation, and governance structure, then executes the escritura pública. The public deed is delivered in engrossed copies for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of company name
Bank deposit certificate for the fully paid-up minimum capital
Draft articles of association and bylaws signed by founders
Valid identity document of each founding shareholder
NIF or NIE of each founder
Statement of quota allocations and payment methods
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requires adjustments to the bylaws or statutory clauses, the founders approve the amendments and re-execute the deed; any defect in the draft may be cured by preparing a corrective addendum before the same notary without losing the original submission date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the provisional tax identification number from the tax authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), office with jurisdiction over the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After execution of the deed and before registry registration, file with AEAT the Modelo 036 or Modelo 030 application for the provisional NIF. Attach the first engrossed copy of the public deed and identification of the acting representative. AEAT issues a provisional NIF that is converted into a definitive NIF once the Mercantile Registry inscription is certified.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the public incorporation deed
Modelo 036 or Modelo 030 tax registration form
Certificate of the administrator's appointment and identification data
NIF/NIE of the requesting representative
Proof of registered-office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected or flagged, correct the activity key on the form and attach the missing certified deed page or representative proof; a written clarification submitted to the AEAT office normally removes the query within three working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the public deed with the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within fifteen calendar days from the date of the deed, submit the first engrossment to the Mercantile Registry together with official filing forms and payment of the statutory scale fee. The registrar reviews the legality of the name, corporate purpose, capital, quota subscriptions, and governance structure. Once registered, the company attains legal personality, the blocked capital becomes available, and the provisional NIF becomes definitive.
required_dossiers: First engrossment of the public incorporation deed
Second engrossment or photocopy for the registry endorsement
Registry name and filing forms
Payment receipt of registry fees
Notarial tax payment stamp, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a notice of defects (nota de calificación), treat it as a registral qualification rather than a rejection; cure the indicated clauses with a corrective public deed, amended articles, or supplementary evidence, and refile within the legal response period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete post-registration governance, tax, social security and municipal filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AEAT, Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS), and the relevant city council (Ayuntamiento)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registry inscription is certified, convert the provisional NIF to the definitive NIF, declare the start of corporate activity and registered office in Modelo 036/037, register the company as an employer with the TGSS before hiring staff, and notify the municipality for the economic activity tax (IAE) and facility opening matters. Adopt the statutory corporate books and the quota ledger.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registration from the Mercantile Registry
Definitive NIF certificate
Modelo 036/037 start-of-activity form
TGSS employer-registration application
Municipal IAE registration or exemption declaration
Corporate governance books and quota ledger
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any post-registration application is queried, submit the certified registry inscription and corrected forms; non-coordination between AEAT and the registry is cured by written rectification requests and presentation of the certified first engrossment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Consejería de Industria of the corresponding Autonomous Community and the municipal licensing authority, together with the national industrial registry under Law 21/1992 on Industry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal operating and opening license (licencia de apertura y funcionamiento), together with the industrial establishment communication or environmental activity authorization required for the production plant

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (MITECO) and the environmental authority of the competent Autonomous Community
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Simplified environmental authorization or municipal activity evaluation; full environmental impact assessment is required only if the cold-foil printing and publishing facility exceeds the Annex II thresholds of Law 21/2013 or generates sensitive hazardous waste streams requiring an integrated environmental permit
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law 34/2007 on air quality and protection of the atmosphere; VOC emission controls under Decree 833/1975 and current best available techniques where applicable; wastewater discharges into municipal sewers governed by local bylaws; hazardous waste handling and traceability under Law 7/2022; packaging waste obligations under the packaging law and extended producer responsibility rules

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by a competent technician or authorized body, fire-protection inspection, civil-defense evacuation plan, structural load and stability certificate for machinery floors, electrical installation certificate, municipal first-occupation verification, and occupational health and safety prevention plan under Law 31/1995 before commencement of production.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – Sede Electrónica: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL) obtains a provisional NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) at incorporation before a notary, with the final definitive NIF issued by the AEAT after registration in the Mercantile Registry. The NIF serves as both the corporate tax identification and the Spanish VAT identification (NIF-IVA). A non-resident shareholder or foreign entity must appoint a tax representative resident in Spain and file Form 036/037 with the AEAT to obtain a non-resident NIF or to register as a non-established taxable person for VAT purposes; registration must occur before commencing any taxable supply in Spain.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; resident SL is taxed under the Spanish Corporate Income Tax Law (Ley 27/2014) on worldwide income; branches of foreign entities are taxed on Spanish-source income only; no pass-through treatment is available for SLs.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box system. Statutory elections available under the Corporate Income Tax Law include the consolidated tax group regime (art. 64), the SOCIMI (REIT) special regime, patent box benefit, R&D and innovation tax credits, and the reduced corporate income tax rate for newly created businesses. Hybrid mismatch and anti-abuse rules under ATAD are mandatory and not elective; all elections must be filed via Form 036 or the annual corporate income tax return within the prescribed deadlines.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido) – Value Added Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 85,000 for supply of goods and EUR 60,000 for supply of services under the simplified SME regime; non-established foreign entities have no economic threshold and must register with AEAT for VAT before making their first taxable supply in Spain.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Spain does not maintain a mandatory real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime for all taxpayers. However, the Suministro Inmediato de Información (SII) requires taxpayers with annual turnover exceeding EUR 6,010,121.04 to submit VAT invoice and transaction records to AEAT electronically in near real time via webservice/API. Under the Verifactu and Crea y Crece regulations, B2B electronic invoicing is mandatory, and billing software must generate certifiable and tamper-evident invoice records; no AEAT pre-approval of each invoice is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of physical goods from Spain to territories outside the European Union qualify for a 0% IVA rate under Article 21 of Ley 37/1992, provided the exporter is the seller or the goods are shipped directly by or on behalf of the supplier and the goods leave the EU within 30 days of delivery. The export must be evidenced by customs documents showing the goods have physically departed the EU. Certain international services, including transport and ancillary services, processing of goods, and cross-border services to non-established businesses, may also be zero-rated where the place of supply is outside Spain or the services are directly linked to exported goods, subject to the general EU B2B place-of-supply rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Documento Único Administrativo – DUA/SAD with customs acceptance and exit confirmation)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR Transport Document evidencing physical departure from the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/payment receipt evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
Commercial invoice, packing list, and proof of contract or purchase order supporting the export transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEAT may retroactively increase or deny the 0% rate if the exporter fails to produce legally sufficient export evidence. Non-compliance triggers the VAT charge at the standard 21% rate plus statutory interest, and improper refund claims are subject to penalties under articles 191 and 194 of the Ley General Tributaria, ranging from 15% to 150% of the tax amount, depending on intent. Falsifying customs or VAT documents may give rise to criminal charges under article 305 of the Spanish Penal Code when the defrauded amount exceeds EUR 120,000. Fiscal clawbacks are generally limited to the four-year prescription period, but limitation is suspended in cases of fraud or failure to file returns.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), in coordination with the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (DGCIIN) of the Ministerio de Economía, Comercio y Empresa, and SEPBLAC (Servicio Ejecutivo de la Comisión de Prevención del Blanqueo de Capitales e Infracciones Monetarias) for AML/CFT supervision.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain maintains full current and capital account convertibility by force of Article 63 TFEU and EU Directive 88/361/EEC. No exchange authorization is required for EUR, USD, CNY or any convertible currency flows for a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL). Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted but require: (1) formal dividend resolution recorded in the Junta General notarial deed; (2) distributable-reserve certification prepared under Spanish GAAP; (3) Impuesto sobre Sociedades settlement evidencing post-tax distributable earnings; and (4) statistical Balance of Payments declaration (Declaración de Operaciones con el Exterior, S-1 form) to Banco de España for any transaction equal to or above EUR 50,000. Non-resident dividend withholding is 19% default, reduced to 0% for EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive qualified parents, or treaty-reduced (US 0%-5%; China 10%; Mexico 10%; Brazil 15%). No capital controls, minimum holding period, or prior authorization apply to inbound foreign capital into an SL.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender, repatriation deadline, or mandatory conversion ratio applies to export proceeds in Spain. Export receipts for trading-card print/distribution sales may remain in foreign currency indefinitely. Obligations are limited to: (a) Balance of Payments statistical declaration to Banco de España for receipts equal to or above EUR 50,000 (S-1 portal submission); and (b) customs export documentation (Documento Único Administrativo - DUA) evidencing physical goods movement. Invoice currency is freely negotiable.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Contribution / Escrow Account (Cuenta de Capital) and Operational EUR Account
Operational EUR/USD multicurrency account with global trade services
Operational Account with integrated merchant acquiring (Redsys) for card sales
Operational Account plus Trade Finance (Documentary L/Cs, guarantees)
Operational Account and FX hedging desk access

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-High for operational clearing; Low for capital escrow purposes. Spain-licensed EMIs (authorized by Banco de España under Law 21/2011 implementing PSD2) and EU-passported EMIs (Wise Business, Revolut Business, MangoPay, Currencycloud) may lawfully hold an SL's treasury and route SEPA/SWIFT payments. Legal constraints: (a) capital-injection escrow accounts are discouraged because EMIs do not file Banco de España S-1 balance-of-payments declarations and may reject the 'capital contribution' purpose code; (b) non-EU EMIs cannot passport into Spain and must contract as agent of an authorized EMI; (c) card-print supplier settlements in USD/CNY require the EMI to maintain SWIFT correspondent access. Recommended structure: EMI as settlement-only node (Stripe/MangoPay for card sales; Wise for USD supplier clearing) with the Santander/BBVA account as the anchor treasury account performing all BOP reporting.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory in-person interview at a mainland branch for at least one director/legal representative during initial onboarding is the prevailing Tier-1 practice (Santander, BBVA, CaixaBank). Remote video onboarding is permitted only for EU-resident directors holding a Spanish NIE or entities represented by an appointed local power-of-attorney holder (poder notarial) who attends the interview. Non-EU directors without NIE must appear personally or appoint a Spanish resident representative with notarized, apostilled power. All corporate documents must be notarized/apostilled and translated by a certified sworn translator (traductor jurado) when requested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident UBO with no prior Spanish financial footprint and contributions sourced from an overseas parent entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Notarized and apostilled deed of incorporation (escritura de constitución); (2) registral certificate of the foreign parent; (3) UBO declaration identifying all natural persons >25%; (4) three-month bank statements from the home-country relationship bank; (5) Spanish NIE/TIE of managing director; (6) certified Spanish translations (traductor jurado); (7) signed business plan with 24-month cash-flow projection; (8) lease or warehousing agreement proving Spanish business nexus; (9) source-of-wealth letter for the capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-ticket digital card sales generating 200-5,000 small credit-card transactions monthly (platform collection typology).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Executed distribution agreements with licensed IP owners (Panini, Topps, or documented sub-license chain to issuer); (2) Stripe/Authorize.Net merchant statements showing settlement history; (3) holographic cold-foil production contracts and supplier purchase orders; (4) intellectual-property indemnity insurance certificate; (5) e-commerce site order flow and platform architecture description.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Supply-chain payments to counterparties in China/Hong Kong or Latin America flagged as higher-risk corridors (FATF grey-list or enhanced-jurisdiction typologies).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Full supply-chain diagram manufacturer to warehousing to EU distribution; (2) commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and customs DUAs for at least three historical shipments; (3) ISO 9001 or equivalent manufacturer certificates; (4) bank reference letter from the supplier's bank (SWIFT); (5) supplier UBO certificate (when available); (6) written representation of no relationship with shell/front companies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital contribution or shareholder loan disproportionate to declared revenue or company activity scale.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (1) Certified capital increase deed (escritura de ampliación de capital) or shareholder loan agreement (contrato de préstamo entre socios); (2) source-of-wealth declaration (declaración de patrimonio) from the contributing shareholder; (3) audited financial statements or modelo 200 tax return of the parent; (4) AEAT tax clearance certificate (certificado de estar al corriente); (5) board resolution authorizing the treasury transaction.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: (1) SWIFT MT103 from the foreign parent to the SL's EUR IBAN via TARGET2 (T2) using corporate purpose code CAPL or 'Capital contribution' in field 70; (2) intra-EU injection may use SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) or SEPA Instant (SCT Inst, up to EUR 100,000 per instruction); (3) treat as Inversión Extranjera Directa (IED) and file the Post-Investment Declaration (Declaración Posterior de Inversión Extranjera) with the Registro de Inversiones Exteriores within one month of settlement; (4) simultaneous electronic S-1 submission to Banco de España via the DEC portal when transaction value equals or exceeds EUR 50,000; (5) supporting pack: notarized board resolution, share-issue certificate (certificado de titularidad), bank credit advice, and registry filing receipt.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails for physical trading-card supply: (1) SWIFT MT103 for high-value supplier payments to China (USD/CNY via CHIPS/CIPS correspondents) and SCT for EU printers; (2) confirmed irrevocable Documentary Letter of Credit (UCP 600) when initial supplier onboarding or payment terms exceed 30 days and the order is above EUR 50,000; (3) Commercial LC with 'bill of lading' and 'inspection certificate' as required documents; (4) payment terms of 30% TT advance plus 70% against B/L copy via MT103 for established suppliers; (5) for EU cross-border settlement, TARGET2-SEPA direct IBAN transfer; (6) settlement instruction must carry full invoice number, DUA customs reference, and ISO 20022 purpose code GDDS for goods imports; (7) for repatriation of US platform proceeds (Stripe), use USD accumulation in an EU EMI or direct SWIFT MT103 to the SL's EUR account with purpose code 'proceeds of goods sold'.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD forward contracts (contratos a plazo) executed OTC under ISDA 2002 or the Spanish Contrato Marco de Operaciones Financieras (CMOF); no exchange license required when hedging documented commercial exposure.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on CNY, MXN, and BRL for settling trade-invoice exposure where the underlying currency is non-convertible offshore; permitted when documented as hedge for forecasted card-printing imports or LatAm distribution receipts.
Cross-currency swaps (permutas de divisas / FX swaps) converting USD sales proceeds into EUR working capital while avoiding active spot-market round-tripping.

Plain-vanilla purchased FX call/put options (MiFID II non-complex status) to cap procurement currency upside; requires professional-client opt-up, documented hedge ratio under EMIR clearing thresholds, and execution under an investment-services agreement (Contrato de Servicios de Inversión) where NDFs are involved.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: One month after approval of the annual accounts by the General Meeting of Shareholders, or by 30 June of the following year if approval is not obtained earlier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines between 3,000 and 15,000 EUR, potential administrative strike-off proceedings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if the SL exceeds two of the following criteria: total assets exceeding 2,850,000 EUR, net turnover exceeding 5,700,000 EUR, or average number of employees exceeding 50
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad - PGC)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The beneficial owners register must be maintained and updated upon any modification to shareholding or control structures; annual review is recommended but not a formal filing requirement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% general statutory Corporate Income Tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) applicable to a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada for fiscal year 2025
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No territorial tax holidays are available in mainland Spain; preferential rates apply only in narrow statutory cases: (i) 15% startup rate under Law 28/2022 for newly created qualifying entities, applicable to the first period with a positive tax base and the two immediately subsequent periods; (ii) temporary reduced rates of 23% (FY2023) and 24% (FY2024) for entities with net turnover below EUR 1,000,000, reverting to 25% from FY2025; (iii) 4% rate for qualifying entities operating in the Zona Especial Canaria; (iv) patent box regime providing 60% exemption of qualifying IP income subject to the nexus ratio; (v) deduction for R&D and innovation activities (Art. 39 LIS); (vi) deductions to avoid double taxation (Arts. 31 and 32 LIS); (vii) tax credit for reinvestment of extraordinary income (Art. 42 LIS).
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_regime_note: Substantive Spanish law provides an unlimited carryforward of tax losses generated from 1 January 2016 onward (Art. 26 LIS). Compensation of prior-year losses (bases imponibles negativas) is capped annually at 70% of the positive taxable base where net turnover is below EUR 1,000,000, 60% where turnover is between EUR 1,000,000 and EUR 20,000,000, and 50% where turnover exceeds EUR 20,000,000. The schema integer of 5 years is retained as a UI display default only and does not reflect any Spanish statutory expiry.
